title: Heat Building Into the 80s and 90s Across Arkansas Including Fort Smith Little Rock Russellville and Texarkana This Wednesday Afternoon - NewsBreak
text:
By Avery Hughes ,
11 hours ago ARKANSAS — A noticeable warmup is arriving across Arkansas this Wednesday afternoon, with high temperatures climbing well into the 80s statewide and a few spots potentially touching the low 90s by mid-afternoon. The region has enjoyed a stretch of cooler than average temperatures recently, making today’s heat buildup a sharp and noticeable shift for residents heading outdoors. Widespread mid to upper 80s are expected from the River Valley through central and southern Arkansas, with the warmest readings concentrated across the southern tier of the state. Read full article
